description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing LLM cost records, including CRUD operations with tenant enforcement, Swagger API documentation, and middleware for authentication and tenant scoping.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Middleware to enforce authentication, tenant requirement, and tenant scope on all routes.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing LLM cost records with optional pagination, filtering, and sorting.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for retrieving a specific LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an LLM cost record by ID.
